anchors.quote:
HAVE ADOPTED THIS REGULATION:
Article 1
Amendments
Regulation (EC) No 1606/2002 is hereby amended as follows:
1.
Article 3(1) shall be replaced by the following:
‘1.   The Commission shall decide on the applicability within the Community of international accounting standards. Those measures, designed to amend non-essential elements of this Regulation by supplementing it, shall be adopted in accordance with the regulatory procedure with scrutiny referred to in Article 6(2).’;
2.
Article 6 shall be amended as follows:
(a)
paragraph 2 shall be replaced by the following:
‘2.   Where reference is made to this paragraph, Article 5a(1) to (4) and Article 7 of Decision 1999/468/EC shall apply, having regard to the provisions of Article 8 thereof.’;
(b)
paragraph 3 shall be deleted.
Article 2
Entry into force
This Regulation shall enter into force on the day following its publication in the
Official Journal of the European Union
.
This Regulation shall be binding in its entirety and directly applicable in all Member States.

dates.reasoning: Procedural changes were in force before both periods. No issuer accounting transition is specified in these Articles.

decisions.reasoning: Article 1 replaces 1606/2002 Article 3(1), replaces Article 6(2), and deletes Article 6(3). It changes Commission adoption procedures, not Article 4 company/reporting criteria. This limited comparison follows from the complete amendment instructions, not the title.
decisions.transition_reasoning: Procedural changes were in force before both periods. No issuer accounting transition is specified in these Articles.
decisions.operation_effect: The same conditional Article 4 scope remains; this amendment supplies no instrument posting or note measurement rule.

anchors.quote: a derivative that will be settled only by the issuer exchanging a fixed amount of cash or another financial asset for a fixed number of its own equity instruments.

dates.mandatory_application: Existing-preparer application in original 2024/2025 reports is conditional on the remaining amendment/transition review.

decisions.reasoning: Paragraph 16 requires both absence of the specified contractual cash/unfavourable-exchange obligation and the applicable own-equity settlement condition. The bond as a whole has coupon and principal cash obligations and is not thereby all equity. Only its fixed conversion feature is a candidate equity component. The assumed ordinary shares are neither puttable nor liquidation-exception instruments; no separate cash settlement of the option is allowed.
decisions.transition_reasoning: The adopted original provision predates both periods. Existing IFRS preparation is assumed; no first-time adoption, early adoption or later comparative restatement is modelled. Its current wording still depends on the separately queued amendment/corrigendum review.
decisions.operation_effect: Conditions issue classification and ensuing financing_equity note; it does not compute the liability/equity split.
decisions.unresolved_question: Complete IAS 32.28–32/AG31 compound classification and measurement, then remaining amendment review; this row tests only eligibility.

anchors.quote: a contract that will be settled by the entity (receiving or) delivering a fixed number of its own equity instruments in exchange for a fixed amount of cash or another financial asset is an equity instrument.

dates.mandatory_application: Existing-preparer application in original 2024/2025 reports is conditional on the remaining amendment/transition review.

decisions.reasoning: The option exchanges fixed AUD principal 100 for ten ordinary issuer shares at maturity. Paragraph 22 expressly includes an option exercised for a fixed stated principal amount of a bond. AUD is also the functional currency; no variable cash amount or variable share number is assumed and no foreign-currency rights exception is needed. This conclusion concerns option eligibility, not whole-instrument classification.
decisions.transition_reasoning: The adopted original provision predates both periods. Existing IFRS preparation is assumed; no first-time adoption, early adoption or later comparative restatement is modelled. Its current wording still depends on the separately queued amendment/corrigendum review.
decisions.operation_effect: Conditions the issue event and financing_equity disclosure dependency; split amounts and maturity accounting are deferred.
decisions.unresolved_question: Resolve compound classification under IAS 32.28–32/AG31 and applicable amendments before deriving a numerical EU split.

anchors.quote: the contract is a financial asset or a financial liability.

dates.mandatory_application: Existing-preparer application in original 2024/2025 reports is conditional on the remaining amendment/transition review.

decisions.reasoning: Paragraph 22A prevents equity treatment of contracts settled in the special puttable or liquidation-obligation instruments described there, even at fixed quantities. The delivered shares are assumed to be ordinary nonputtable residual interests without such obligations; being labelled shares alone would not establish this.
decisions.transition_reasoning: The adopted original provision predates both periods. Existing IFRS preparation is assumed; no first-time adoption, early adoption or later comparative restatement is modelled. Its current wording still depends on the separately queued amendment/corrigendum review.
decisions.operation_effect: Conditions the same issue/equity-note dependency; a change in share rights triggers reanalysis before issuance.

dates.mandatory_application: Existing-preparer application in original 2024/2025 reports is conditional on the remaining amendment/transition review.

decisions.reasoning: AG29 requires all agreements between group members and external holders to be considered in consolidated classification. External holders and absence of additional parent/subsidiary guarantees or settlement arrangements are explicit synthetic assumptions, not findings about a real group. Accordingly no additional group obligation is introduced by this fixture.
decisions.transition_reasoning: The adopted original provision predates both periods. Existing IFRS preparation is assumed; no first-time adoption, early adoption or later comparative restatement is modelled. Its current wording still depends on the separately queued amendment/corrigendum review.
decisions.operation_effect: Conditions all consolidated event/note interpretations; the issuer-only contract would be insufficient if an additional group obligation existed.
decisions.unresolved_question: Verify all group-holder terms for any real application; complete compound and amendment decisions for this synthetic fixture. No consolidation method is established.

anchors.quote: financial instruments issued by the entity that meet the definition of an equity instrument in IAS 32

dates.mandatory_application: Existing-preparer application in original 2024/2025 reports is conditional on the remaining amendment/transition review.

decisions.reasoning: Issued instruments meeting IAS 32 equity definitions, including qualifying options, are outside issuer IFRS 9 accounting under 2.1(d). The holder generally applies IFRS 9, subject to its own exceptions. Thus a qualifying issuer conversion-equity component must not acquire an IFRS 9 amortised-cost path. This does not exclude the bond liability; its IFRS 9 eligibility and measurement exceptions remain queued.
decisions.transition_reasoning: The adopted original provision predates both periods. Existing IFRS preparation is assumed; no first-time adoption, early adoption or later comparative restatement is modelled. Its current wording still depends on the separately queued amendment/corrigendum review.
decisions.operation_effect: Separates the proposed conversion_equity and liability dependencies for issue, accrual and notes without measuring either.
decisions.unresolved_question: Resolve compound classification and IFRS 9.4.2.1/4.3.3–4.3.5 exceptions and amendment applicability before admitting liability measurement.

anchors.quote: The issuer of such an instrument does not have the unconditional right to avoid delivering cash or another financial asset

dates.mandatory_application: Existing-preparer application in original 2024/2025 reports is conditional on the remaining amendment/transition review.

decisions.reasoning: No contingent cash-settlement trigger beyond the stated contractual debt payments is assumed for the conversion feature. IAS 32.25 cannot be bypassed for a real contingent trigger merely by calling it unlikely; the paragraph gives specific exceptions. None of those exceptions is invoked here.
decisions.transition_reasoning: The adopted original provision predates both periods. Existing IFRS preparation is assumed; no first-time adoption, early adoption or later comparative restatement is modelled. Its current wording still depends on the separately queued amendment/corrigendum review.
decisions.operation_effect: Conditions issue and equity-note dependencies; both maturity outcomes remain proposed, without changing the lifecycle guard.

anchors.quote: unless all of the settlement alternatives would result in it being an equity instrument.

dates.mandatory_application: Existing-preparer application in original 2024/2025 reports is conditional on the remaining amendment/transition review.

decisions.reasoning: The conversion feature has no net-cash settlement alternative; exercise delivers fixed shares. Non-exercise leads to repayment of the separate debt obligation, not net-cash settlement of the derivative option. Full compound accounting under paragraphs 28–29 is deferred, so this does not classify the whole bond as equity.
